description: Submit a completed Android build to Google Play. Production uploads are committed as a draft unless release_status is set to completed.

release_notes.description: Release notes to attach to the Google Play release, up to 500 characters

release_status.description: Release status: draft stages the release in the Play Console (default on the production track), completed publishes a live release

rollout_percentage.description: Staged rollout percentage for a live release, greater than 0 and less than 100. Requires release_status completed

name: ubriot_submit_google_play
